notes.title: Version 1.3.0 is now released!
notes.content:
Hello!

A new update has been released, the changes are outlined below:

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [i]Loop[/i] switch in simulation settings which causes particles to loop around the boundary instead of being clamped to boundary.
[*] Improved simulation quality by introducing sub-stepping. This should alleviate some particle jitter behavior that may arise in certain situations.
[*] Camera gets centered around the domain boundary when entering simulation mode.
[*] Added version text in the lower-right corner of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes 26 April
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Updated damping particle behavior.
[*] Updated avoidance particle behavior.
[*] Added a new simulation settings slider called "Cohesion". The cohesion controls how strongly the particles move toward the average position of their local particle neighbors.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes 21 April
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix issue where first simulation is reloaded when entering the Edit Simulation panel.
[*] Load a randomized simulation when the game starts instead of loading first available simulation.
[*] Automatically start the simulation when entering the simulation panel.
[*] The Simulation panel is now the default panel when the game starts.
[/list]
